mainEntity.name: How long does a typical casement window installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for casement windows can vary depending on the number of windows, their size, and the complexity of the existing framing. Generally, a single casement window replacement might take half a day, while a full home installation could span several days. At Hometelligent Inc., we typically provide a detailed project timeline during the initial consultation, factoring in necessary preparation, removal of old windows, and finishing work. This upfront clarity helps manage expectations regarding the project's duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, but a single window can take half a day, with full home projects spanning several days. We provide a detailed timeline during consultation.
